description.value:
When Arasaka rebuilt the Ashura for precision analog sniping, Techtronika wanted to do the same, but bigger and bolder. So, they bumped it up to an .70-cal AE round, gave it a semi-automatic action, made the barrel heavy as hell to (barely) compensate for the recoil, and shipped it. As one might expect, the SPT-64 Kondensator does not operate efficiently, reliably, or comfortably. But, it can blow a hole clean through a bunker wall at a low price, so it still has some merit for the desperate.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: PQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Sniper Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 5 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Bipod, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: All Ammunition fired from this weapon functions like an Explosive when hitting Cover for the purposes of carrying damage to targets behind cover. Requires BODY 13+, or BODY 11+ and being Prone, to wield unless Mounted. When a non-FBC user without a Cyberskull rolls a Critical Failure (1) with this weapon, instead of it jamming, the user suffers the effects (but not Bonus Damage) of the Concussion and Damaged Ear Critical Injuries until the end of their next Turn.

Range: Sniper Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
